$comment: RoRoRo web marketplace data. Catalog identity comes from the same plugins-catalog.json the app reads; version/date/installs come from each plugin repo’s live releases.

plugins.name: RoRoRo Ur AFK
plugins.description: Keeps idle Roblox accounts alive — focuses each and taps space before the ~20-minute idle timeout. One toggle, one key ever sent.

plugins.name: RoRoRo Ur MCP
plugins.description: Drive RoRoRo from Claude. A stdio MCP server Claude Code / Claude Desktop launches, authorized as this consent-gated plugin: list and launch accounts, follow the main, watch presence, stop clients, and run or stop Ur Task macros. Autostart stays off — Claude owns the process.

plugins.name: RoRoRo Ur OCR
plugins.description: Watches user-defined screen regions for text or color triggers and fires keybinds when they match. Pairs with Ur Task over the action bridge for perception-to-action.

plugins.name: RoRoRo Ur Task
plugins.description: Per-window-aware macro recording for RoRoRo-managed alts. Record once, play on any alt — round-robin assignments, keep-alive, window-relative mouse macros, and an action bridge for sibling plugins.
